_source: Feature 035 T045e. The ONE tracked class -> GrammarCategory mapping. guard_comparisons_performed (debug/fullsweep/guards.py:323) keys its counters on CATEGORY; every plane-2 surface (census_fields, coverage.classify_coverage, coverage-floor.json in_scope_classes) keys on CLASS. This file is the join, and it is SHARED: feature 038's per-class census reads the same document. Do not fork a second copy inside debug/fullsweep/ -- a class-to-category mapping that disagrees between the two instruments is a silent divergence neither one can detect.
_shared_with: specs/038-transfer-fidelity-gaps/contracts/census-artifact.schema.json -- its classRow 'class' plus optional 'owning_feature_system' are the join key this file reproduces exactly, so a feature-system-split census row joins to exactly one category.
_not_a_default: A class whose 'categories' is empty carries a NON-NULL 'unmapped_reason' and MUST be reported not-evaluated at the category plane, never folded into a category's clean tally (FR-109, FR-136, FR-137). A reader that silently treats an empty list as 'no findings' reproduces the exact defect this feature exists to catch.

unmapped_class_reasons.post-pass-no-category: Created by a post-pass over ctx._copy_set rather than by any category's execute_action, so no category can be credited with creating it.
unmapped_class_reasons.reference-create-arm-only: Created on demand by the reference CREATE arm (Lib/references.py:1119) under whichever category is resolving the referring field. It has no category of its own, and no single category may claim coverage of it.
unmapped_class_reasons.never-created-referenced-only: Referenced by the engine but created by no path at all. Every source project using it registers a permanent expected loss (object-inventory.md G4.8).

categoryless_reasons.no-lcm-object-created: The category dispatches and does real work, but creates no LCM object on the coverage floor -- it wires references or mutates schema. Zero comparisons is CORRECT for it, and is not evidence of coverage.
categoryless_reasons.configuration-artifact-not-an-lcm-object: The category's product is a TABLE 4 configuration artifact, not an LCM object on the coverage floor.
categoryless_reasons.phase0-surface-category-not-in-full-run-: A Phase-0 MVP surface category used by transfer_verb_vertical and absent from transfer.py _LEAF_DISPATCH_CATEGORIES. A full run never dispatches it, so it can neither be measured nor reported clean.

ADJUDICATED. object-inventory.md TABLE 1 lists this row as 'AFFIXES, STEMS (created only in the STEMS tail)'. Gap analysis G3 measures the parenthetical: _run_entryref_create_pass and _run_post_pass_a are invoked ONLY from stems_execute_action (Lib/categories.py:7714-7718), so nothing creates a LexEntryRef under AFFIXES. Mapping it to affixes would let an affixes-only run report coverage of a class it cannot create, which is exactly FR-137's defect; the map therefore records STEMS alone.

Reachable only as a Segment.AnalysesRS alignment token under TEXTS, and _normalize_token_to_analysis maps IPunctuationForm to None (Lib/wordforms.py:380) -- GramTrans has no create site for it. T045d additionally found ReversalIndexOperations does not override GetSyncableProperties, so its fields are currently unreadable by the census (T070).
